audit_items.proof_trace: All mutation Server Actions (registerNewMember, updateMyProfile, updateMemberAdmin, etc.) return only {error: string|null} with no discord_uid or email. The getAllMemberNames() action returns discord UIDs as map keys but enforces authentication (returns null for unauthenticated callers) and Discord user IDs are semi-public platform identifiers, not private PII. The /oauth/userinfo endpoint intentionally returns discord_id per OAuth 2.0 spec and is an HTTP Route Handler, not a Server Action — outside this property's scope.
